en: Power Management Bus. An open, SMBus/I²C-based command protocol for configuring, controlling and monitoring power converters. Part I covers transport and electrical; Part II defines the command set and data formats (LINEAR11, LINEAR16, DIRECT, VID).
zh: 電源管理匯流排。基於 SMBus/I²C 的開放式命令協定，用於設定、控制與監控電源轉換器。Part I 定義傳輸與電氣規格；Part II 定義命令集與資料格式（LINEAR11、LINEAR16、DIRECT、VID）。

sources.title: PMBus specifications (pmbus.org)

en: System Management Bus. A two-wire bus derived from I²C with tighter timing (e.g. clock-low timeout), optional Packet Error Checking and an alert line (SMBALERT#). PMBus runs on top of SMBus.
zh: 系統管理匯流排。源自 I²C 的雙線匯流排，時序規範較嚴格（例如 clock-low timeout），支援選用的封包錯誤檢查（PEC）與警示腳位 SMBALERT#。PMBus 建構在 SMBus 之上。

sources.title: SMBus specification (smbus.org)

en: An optional CRC-8 byte (polynomial x⁸ + x² + x + 1, 0x07) appended to SMBus/PMBus transactions, computed over all bytes including the address bytes.
zh: 選用的 CRC-8 檢查位元組（多項式 x⁸ + x² + x + 1，即 0x07），附加在 SMBus/PMBus 交易後，計算範圍涵蓋位址在內的所有位元組。

en: PMBus 16-bit linear format for most non-output-voltage values. Bits [15:11] are a 5-bit two's-complement exponent N; bits [10:0] are an 11-bit two's-complement mantissa Y. Value X = Y · 2^N.
zh: PMBus 用於大部分非輸出電壓參數的 16 位元線性格式。位元 [15:11] 為 5 位元二補數指數 N；位元 [10:0] 為 11 位元二補數尾數 Y。實際值 X = Y · 2^N。

sources.title: TI UCD90320 – Distinguishing between linear data formats

en: PMBus format for output-voltage commands (VOUT_COMMAND, READ_VOUT, …). The 16-bit word is an unsigned mantissa V; the exponent N comes from the lower 5 bits of VOUT_MODE (two's complement). Value X = V · 2^N.
zh: PMBus 輸出電壓相關命令（VOUT_COMMAND、READ_VOUT 等）所用格式。16 位元字組為無號尾數 V；指數 N 取自 VOUT_MODE 的低 5 位元（二補數）。實際值 X = V · 2^N。

en: One-byte PMBus command describing how output-voltage values are encoded. Bits [7:5] select the mode (000 = Linear, 001 = VID, 010 = Direct, 011 = IEEE half precision in PMBus 1.3+); bits [4:0] are the parameter (the exponent in Linear mode, the VID code type in VID mode).
zh: 描述輸出電壓數值編碼方式的單位元組 PMBus 命令。位元 [7:5] 選擇模式（000 = Linear、001 = VID、010 = Direct、011 = IEEE 半精度，PMBus 1.3 以後）；位元 [4:0] 為參數（Linear 模式時為指數，VID 模式時為 VID 碼型）。

sources.title: TI TPS546C23 – VOUT_MODE (20h)

en: PMBus format where the device publishes coefficients m (slope), b (offset) and R (exponent). Encode: Y = (m·X + b) · 10^R. Decode: X = (Y · 10^−R − b) / m. Y is a 16-bit two's-complement integer.
zh: PMBus 的一種資料格式，裝置提供係數 m（斜率）、b（偏移）與 R（指數）。編碼：Y = (m·X + b) · 10^R；解碼：X = (Y · 10^−R − b) / m。Y 為 16 位元二補數整數。

sources.title: PMBus – Direct Data Transfer Format (APEC 2017)

en: PMBus block-read command that returns the m, b and R coefficients a device uses for a given command in DIRECT format.
zh: PMBus 區塊讀取命令，回傳裝置在 DIRECT 格式下某命令所使用的 m、b、R 係數。

en: A coded output-voltage setting defined by the processor vendor (e.g. Intel VR12/VR13, AMD SVI). The code-to-voltage table depends on the VID type selected in VOUT_MODE.
zh: 由處理器廠商定義的輸出電壓編碼（例如 Intel VR12/VR13、AMD SVI）。編碼與電壓的對應表取決於 VOUT_MODE 所選的 VID 類型。

zhTerm: 自適應電壓調整匯流排
en: Adaptive Voltage Scaling Bus, added in PMBus 1.3. A fast point-to-point 3-wire interface (clock, data in, data out) that lets a load such as an ASIC or FPGA adjust its supply voltage in real time.
zh: 自適應電壓調整匯流排，於 PMBus 1.3 加入。高速點對點三線介面（時脈、資料輸入、資料輸出），讓 ASIC、FPGA 等負載即時調整供電電壓。

en: Fixed-point notation: m integer bits (excluding sign) and n fractional bits in a signed two's-complement word. Resolution is 2^−n; range is −2^m to 2^m − 2^−n. Example: Q15 (Q0.15) in 16 bits spans −1 to 0.99997.
zh: 定點數表示法：在有號二補數字組中，m 個整數位元（不含符號位）與 n 個小數位元。解析度為 2^−n；範圍為 −2^m 至 2^m − 2^−n。例如 16 位元的 Q15（Q0.15）範圍為 −1 至 0.99997。

en: Representing fractional numbers as scaled integers so that a controller without an FPU can run control loops quickly. Multiplying two Q-numbers adds their fractional bits, so results must be shifted back and checked for overflow.
zh: 以縮放後的整數表示小數，讓沒有 FPU 的控制器也能快速執行控制迴路。兩個 Q 格式數相乘時小數位數相加，因此結果需右移還原並檢查溢位。

en: TI library and convention for 32-bit fixed-point math on C2000 MCUs, where a global Q value (GLOBAL_Q, typically 24) sets the fractional bits of the _iq type.
zh: TI 在 C2000 MCU 上使用的 32 位元定點運算函式庫與慣例，以全域 Q 值（GLOBAL_Q，通常為 24）決定 _iq 型別的小數位數。

en: Limiting a value to its representable or allowed range instead of letting it wrap around on overflow. Essential for duty cycle, integrator state and compensator outputs.
zh: 數值溢位時將其限制在可表示或允許的範圍內，而不是讓它回繞。對佔空比、積分器狀態與補償器輸出都非常重要。

en: A PWM generator driven by a counter clocked at f_clk. The number of counts per switching period sets duty-cycle resolution: N_bits = log₂(f_clk / f_sw) for up-count mode (one bit less for up-down count).
zh: 由 f_clk 驅動之計數器所產生的 PWM。每個開關週期的計數數量決定佔空比解析度：上數模式 N_bits = log₂(f_clk / f_sw)（上下數模式少 1 位元）。

en: The smallest duty-cycle (or time) step a PWM can produce. Time step = 1/f_clk (or the HRPWM step); duty step = time step × f_sw. For a buck converter the output voltage step is roughly V_in × duty step.
zh: PWM 能產生的最小佔空比（或時間）步階。時間步階 = 1/f_clk（或 HRPWM 步階）；佔空比步階 = 時間步階 × f_sw。對 Buck 轉換器而言輸出電壓步階約為 V_in × 佔空比步階。

en: PWM hardware that places edges with sub-clock-cycle precision, typically using delay lines (e.g. TI C2000 micro-edge positioner, ~150 ps steps). It raises effective resolution at high switching frequencies.
zh: 能以小於一個時脈週期的精度放置 PWM 邊緣的硬體，通常以延遲線實現（例如 TI C2000 的 MEP，步階約 150 ps）。可在高開關頻率下提高有效解析度。

en: Alternating the duty cycle between adjacent DPWM levels over several switching periods so the average duty has finer resolution than the hardware step. Increases effective resolution at the cost of low-frequency ripple.
zh: 在數個開關週期間交替使用相鄰的 DPWM 階層，使平均佔空比的解析度高於硬體步階。可提升有效解析度，代價是出現低頻漣波。

sources.title: Peterchev – Digital Control of PWM Converters (UC Berkeley EECS-2006-146)

en: The voltage represented by one ADC code: LSB = V_ref / 2^N. Referred to the converter output through a divider of gain k, the output-voltage LSB is V_ref / (2^N · k).
zh: ADC 一個碼所代表的電壓：LSB = V_ref / 2^N。若經增益為 k 的分壓器回授，對應到輸出電壓的 LSB 為 V_ref / (2^N · k)。

en: A small-range, high-resolution ADC that digitises only the difference between the reference and the feedback voltage (used in TI UCD controllers). It gives fine resolution around the set point without needing a high-bit ADC.
zh: 只數位化參考電壓與回授電壓差值的小範圍高解析 ADC（用於 TI UCD 控制器）。不需高位元 ADC 即可在設定點附近取得精細解析度。

en: Effective Number Of Bits: the resolution an ADC actually delivers once noise and distortion are included. ENOB = (SINAD − 1.76 dB) / 6.02 dB.
zh: 有效位元數：考慮雜訊與失真後 ADC 實際提供的解析度。ENOB = (SINAD − 1.76 dB) / 6.02 dB。

en: A steady-state oscillation in a digitally controlled converter caused by quantization in the ADC and DPWM. A necessary condition (Peterchev & Sanders, 2003) is that the output-voltage step of one DPWM LSB is smaller than the ADC LSB referred to the output, and the loop has integral action. This is necessary, not sufficient.
zh: 數位控制轉換器中，由 ADC 與 DPWM 量化所造成的穩態振盪。必要條件（Peterchev & Sanders, 2003）為：一個 DPWM LSB 造成的輸出電壓步階須小於換算到輸出端的 ADC LSB，且迴路具有積分作用。此為必要條件而非充分條件。

sources.title: Peterchev & Sanders, Quantization resolution and limit cycling in digitally controlled PWM converters (IEEE TPEL 2003)
Univ. of Toronto – limit cycle analysis

en: Two-pole/two-zero discrete compensator, the digital counterpart of an analog Type II. Difference equation: u[n] = B0·e[n] + B1·e[n−1] + B2·e[n−2] − A1·u[n−1] − A2·u[n−2].
zh: 兩極點／兩零點離散補償器，對應類比 Type II。差分方程式：u[n] = B0·e[n] + B1·e[n−1] + B2·e[n−2] − A1·u[n−1] − A2·u[n−2]。
formula: H(z) = (B0 + B1 z⁻¹ + B2 z⁻²) / (1 + A1 z⁻¹ + A2 z⁻²)

sources.title: Microchip – Digital Compensators (2P2Z & 3P3Z)

en: Three-pole/three-zero discrete compensator, the digital counterpart of an analog Type III, used where extra phase boost is needed (e.g. voltage-mode buck with an LC double pole).
zh: 三極點／三零點離散補償器，對應類比 Type III，用於需要更多相位提升的場合（例如具 LC 雙極點的電壓模式 Buck）。
formula: H(z) = (B0 + B1 z⁻¹ + B2 z⁻² + B3 z⁻³) / (1 + A1 z⁻¹ + A2 z⁻² + A3 z⁻³)

sources.title: TI – Digital power supply considerations for the analog engineer (SPRY151)

zhTerm: Type II 補償器（第二型）
en: Analog compensator with an origin pole, one zero and one high-frequency pole. Gives up to 90° of phase boost; typical for current-mode control.
zh: 具原點極點、一個零點與一個高頻極點的類比補償器。最多提供 90° 相位提升，常用於電流模式控制。

zhTerm: Type III 補償器（第三型）
en: Analog compensator with an origin pole, two zeros and two high-frequency poles. Gives up to 180° of phase boost; typical for voltage-mode control.
zh: 具原點極點、兩個零點與兩個高頻極點的類比補償器。最多提供 180° 相位提升，常用於電壓模式控制。

en: Proportional-Integral-Derivative control. In digital power the derivative is usually filtered, which makes a discrete PID equivalent to a 2P2Z.
zh: 比例-積分-微分控制。在數位電源中微分項通常會加上濾波，使離散 PID 等效於 2P2Z。

en: Maps a continuous transfer function to discrete time by substituting s = (2/T)·(z − 1)/(z + 1). It preserves stability; frequency warping can be corrected by pre-warping at a chosen frequency.
zh: 以 s = (2/T)·(z − 1)/(z + 1) 將連續時間轉移函數轉換為離散時間。可保持穩定性；頻率扭曲可藉由在選定頻率預扭曲（pre-warping）修正。

en: Time from ADC sampling to the PWM update, plus the PWM's own zero-order-hold effect. Each delay T_d adds phase lag of 360°·f·T_d, which limits achievable crossover frequency.
zh: 從 ADC 取樣到 PWM 更新所經過的時間，加上 PWM 本身的零階保持效應。每個延遲 T_d 會增加 360°·f·T_d 的相位落後，限制可達成的穿越頻率。

en: Crossover f_c is where loop gain equals 0 dB; phase margin is 180° plus the loop phase at f_c. Digital loops typically target f_c ≤ f_s/10 because of sampling delay; 45°–60° phase margin is common.
zh: 穿越頻率 f_c 為迴路增益等於 0 dB 處；相位裕度為 180° 加上 f_c 處的迴路相位。由於取樣延遲，數位迴路通常設定 f_c ≤ f_s/10；常見相位裕度為 45°–60°。

en: Stops the integrator from accumulating when the output is saturated (e.g. duty at its limit), avoiding large overshoot when the converter leaves saturation.
zh: 在輸出飽和時（例如佔空比到達上限）停止積分器累加，避免轉換器離開飽和時產生大幅過衝。

en: Ramping the reference voltage from zero to the target over a set time (PMBus TON_RISE) to limit inrush current and overshoot.
zh: 在設定時間內（PMBus TON_RISE）將參考電壓由零逐步升至目標值，以限制湧入電流與過衝。

en: Continuous vs. Discontinuous Conduction Mode. In CCM the inductor current never reaches zero; in DCM it does, changing the converter's small-signal model and gain.
zh: 連續與不連續導通模式。CCM 時電感電流不會降到零；DCM 時則會，因而改變轉換器的小信號模型與增益。

en: In an ideal buck in CCM, D = V_out / V_in. Therefore one DPWM duty step ΔD changes V_out by about V_in · ΔD.
zh: 理想 Buck 在 CCM 時 D = V_out / V_in。因此每一個 DPWM 佔空比步階 ΔD 約造成 V_in · ΔD 的輸出電壓變化。

en: A single central supply generates every output rail and delivers them to the loads through cables and bus bars. Simple, but low-voltage, high-current rails suffer large distribution losses and poor transient response at the load.
zh: 由單一中央電源產生所有輸出電壓，經由電纜與匯流排送到各負載。架構簡單，但低電壓、大電流的電源軌在配電路徑上損耗大，負載端的暫態響應也差。

en: Few parts, simple design
One place to cool and monitor
zh: 零件少、設計簡單
散熱與監控集中在一處

en: High I²R loss for low-voltage rails
Slow load transients
Single point of failure
zh: 低壓電源軌 I²R 損耗高
負載暫態響應慢
單點故障

sources.title: Mouser – The Modern Distributed Power Architecture

en: A front end distributes a relatively high bus voltage (e.g. 48 V or 300 V) across the system, and isolated, regulated DC/DC converters ("bricks") near each load produce the final rails. Lower distribution current and easier expansion, at the cost of many isolated converters.
zh: 前級在系統中配送較高的匯流排電壓（例如 48 V 或 300 V），再由靠近各負載的隔離式穩壓 DC/DC 轉換器（「磚型模組」）產生最終電壓。配電電流較小、擴充容易，但需要大量隔離式轉換器。

en: Low distribution current
Easy to add rails
Fault in one converter does not take down the rest
zh: 配電電流低
容易增加電源軌
單一轉換器故障不影響其他

en: Many isolated converters: cost and board area
Each brick needs its own regulation and protection
zh: 需要多個隔離式轉換器，成本與面積高
每個模組都需自己的穩壓與保護

sources.title: DigiKey – Distributed Power Architecture (DPA) Choices Using Power Modules

en: A two-stage refinement of DPA. One isolated bus converter (often unregulated or semi-regulated, fixed ratio) turns 48 V into a 12 V, 9.6 V or 5–8 V intermediate bus; non-isolated point-of-load (niPOL) bucks then regulate each rail. The dominant architecture in telecom, servers and networking boards.
zh: DPA 的兩級式改良。一個隔離式匯流排轉換器（常為非穩壓或半穩壓、固定比例）將 48 V 轉為 12 V、9.6 V 或 5–8 V 的中間匯流排，再由非隔離的負載點（niPOL）Buck 轉換器分別穩壓各電源軌。是通訊、伺服器與網通板卡最主流的架構。

en: Only one isolated stage
Cheap, plentiful POL bucks
Easy to add rails
zh: 只需一級隔離
POL Buck 便宜且選擇多
容易增加電源軌

en: Two conversion stages multiply losses
Intermediate bus voltage is a compromise between distribution loss and POL step-down ratio
zh: 兩級轉換使損耗相乘
中間匯流排電壓需在配電損耗與 POL 降壓比之間取捨

sources.title: Electronic Design – What's the difference between IBA and FPA?
MPS – Two-stage solution for 48 V power distribution

en: The first stage of an IBA: an isolated converter, often a fixed-ratio (e.g. 4:1 or 8:1) DC transformer (DCX) running near 50 % duty for high efficiency. Unregulated types let the bus follow the input; semi-regulated or regulated types narrow the bus range for the POLs.
zh: IBA 的第一級：隔離式轉換器，常為固定比例（例如 4:1 或 8:1）的直流變壓器（DCX），以接近 50% 佔空比運作以取得高效率。非穩壓型的匯流排電壓隨輸入變動；半穩壓或穩壓型則縮小匯流排範圍，方便後級 POL。

en: A non-isolated converter, usually a synchronous buck, placed right next to the load (CPU, FPGA, ASIC, DDR) so the low-voltage, high-current path is as short as possible. Digital POLs add PMBus telemetry, sequencing and margining.
zh: 非隔離轉換器（通常為同步 Buck），放在負載（CPU、FPGA、ASIC、DDR）旁，使低電壓、大電流路徑盡量短。數位 POL 另提供 PMBus 遙測、上電時序與電壓邊際調整功能。

en: Splits the converter into a regulator and a transformer: a pre-regulator (PRM) creates a controlled "factorized bus", and a fixed-ratio current multiplier (VTM) at each load does isolation and step-down. Aimed at very high-current, low-voltage loads. Introduced by Vicor; vendor efficiency and density claims should be checked independently.
zh: 把轉換器拆成「穩壓」與「變壓」兩部分：前級穩壓器（PRM）產生受控的「因式分解匯流排」，再由每個負載旁的固定比例電流倍增器（VTM）負責隔離與降壓。適用於極大電流、低電壓的負載。由 Vicor 提出；廠商宣稱的效率與功率密度數據建議另行驗證。

en: Current multiplication right at the load
Regulation and isolation sized independently
zh: 電流在負載端才倍增
穩壓與隔離可分別最佳化

en: Largely single-vendor ecosystem
Feed-forward regulation across the VTM ratio
zh: 生態系多半依賴單一廠商
需跨越 VTM 變比做前饋穩壓

sources.title: DigiKey – Factorized Power Architecture (FPA)

zhTerm: 48 V 直接轉負載點（單級）
en: Converts the 48 V rack bus (e.g. OCP Open Rack) directly to ~1 V at the processor in one stage, usually with a transformer-based or hybrid switched-capacitor topology. Removes the intermediate bus; competes with two-stage 48 V → 12 V (or 5–8 V) → 1 V solutions.
zh: 將 48 V 機櫃匯流排（例如 OCP Open Rack）以單一級直接轉為處理器所需的約 1 V，通常採用含變壓器或混合式切換電容拓撲。省去中間匯流排；與兩級式 48 V → 12 V（或 5–8 V）→ 1 V 方案互相競爭。

en: One stage, no intermediate bus
Lower distribution current than 12 V racks
zh: 單一級、無中間匯流排
配電電流比 12 V 機櫃低

en: Very high step-down ratio is hard to do efficiently with a plain buck
Less mature, fewer standard parts than two-stage
zh: 極高降壓比難以用一般 Buck 高效實現
成熟度與標準零件數量不如兩級式

sources.title: TI – 48 V power architecture comparison (SSZTB19)
Flex – Power architectures: a direct approach is more efficient

en: The control loop stays analog; a digital block (an on-chip engine or a separate housekeeping MCU / power sequencer) handles configuration, sequencing, margining, fault logging and PMBus telemetry. Keeps proven analog loop behavior while adding observability.
zh: 控制迴路仍為類比；由數位電路（晶片內引擎或獨立的管理 MCU／電源時序控制器）負責設定、上電時序、電壓邊際、故障記錄與 PMBus 遙測。保留成熟的類比迴路特性，同時提升可觀測性。

en: Analog loop bandwidth and no quantization effects
Adds telemetry to existing designs
zh: 類比迴路頻寬高、無量化效應
可為既有設計加上遙測

en: Compensation still set by external R/C
Extra parts if the manager is a separate chip
zh: 補償仍需外部 R/C 設定
若管理器為獨立晶片則需額外零件

sources.title: Power Systems Design – Digital power supply control

zhTerm: 數位控制電源（數位迴路）
en: The feedback loop itself is digital: an ADC (or error ADC) samples the output, a digital compensator (PID / 2P2Z / 3P3Z) computes the duty cycle, and a DPWM drives the switches. Enables adaptive and non-linear control and programmable compensation, but brings sampling delay and quantization (see limit cycles).
zh: 回授迴路本身為數位：ADC（或誤差 ADC）取樣輸出，數位補償器（PID／2P2Z／3P3Z）計算佔空比，再由 DPWM 驅動開關。可實現自適應與非線性控制、補償參數可程式化，但會引入取樣延遲與量化效應（見極限環）。

en: Programmable compensation, no R/C changes
Adaptive, non-linear and multi-mode control
Built-in telemetry
zh: 補償可程式化，不必更換 R/C
可做自適應、非線性與多模式控制
內建遙測

en: Sampling and computation delay limit bandwidth
ADC/DPWM resolution and limit cycles
Firmware and tooling effort
zh: 取樣與運算延遲限制頻寬
ADC／DPWM 解析度與極限環問題
需投入韌體與工具開發

sources.title: TI – Digital control seminar (Topic 7)
Control Engineering – Convert power with digital signal controllers

en: A general-purpose digital signal controller (e.g. TI C2000, Microchip dsPIC33, ST STM32G4) runs the control loop in firmware using on-chip high-resolution PWM, fast ADCs and comparators. Most flexible option: any topology or control law, plus PFC, communications and housekeeping on one chip.
zh: 以通用數位訊號控制器（例如 TI C2000、Microchip dsPIC33、ST STM32G4）在韌體中執行控制迴路，搭配晶片內的高解析 PWM、高速 ADC 與比較器。彈性最高：任何拓撲或控制法則皆可實現，並可在同一顆晶片上整合 PFC、通訊與系統管理。

en: Any topology / control law
One chip for loop, PFC and comms
zh: 可實現任何拓撲與控制法則
迴路、PFC 與通訊整合於一顆晶片

en: Loop rate limited by CPU cycles
Requires firmware development and validation
zh: 迴路更新率受 CPU 週期限制
需開發與驗證韌體

sources.title: element14 – Benefits of digitally controlled DC power

zhTerm: 固定功能／狀態機控制器
en: A dedicated digital power IC whose loop runs in hardware (filter blocks, state machines) and is configured through registers or PMBus with a vendor GUI rather than user firmware. Examples include TI UCD and ADI ADP105x families. Fast to design in, but limited to the topologies the chip supports.
zh: 專用的數位電源 IC，控制迴路由硬體（濾波器區塊、狀態機）執行，透過暫存器或 PMBus 搭配廠商 GUI 設定，而非使用者韌體。例如 TI UCD 與 ADI ADP105x 系列。導入快速，但僅限晶片支援的拓撲。

en: No firmware to write
Hardware loop runs at high sample rates
zh: 不需撰寫韌體
硬體迴路取樣率高

en: Limited to supported topologies and features
Tied to the vendor's design tool
zh: 受限於支援的拓撲與功能
依賴廠商設計工具

sources.title: Analog Devices – Designing digital power supplies with a state machine

en: The control loop is implemented as parallel logic in an FPGA, giving deterministic, very short loop latency and sub-nanosecond PWM via delay lines. Common in research, high-frequency GaN/SiC converters and multi-level inverters; needs HDL skills and external ADCs.
zh: 控制迴路以 FPGA 中的平行邏輯實現，延遲固定且極短，並可藉延遲線產生次奈秒等級的 PWM。常見於研究、高頻 GaN／SiC 轉換器與多階逆變器；需要 HDL 能力並搭配外部 ADC。

en: Lowest, deterministic latency
Massive parallelism for multi-phase / multi-level
zh: 延遲最低且固定
高度平行，適合多相／多階

en: HDL design effort
Higher cost and power than a DSC
zh: 需投入 HDL 設計
成本與功耗高於 DSC

en: Controller that drives several interleaved buck phases (with smart power stages) for CPU/GPU/AI-accelerator rails. Digital loops add phase shedding, current balancing, AVS/SVID/SVI3 interfaces, non-linear transient response and PMBus telemetry.
zh: 驅動多個交錯 Buck 相位（搭配智慧功率級）的控制器，用於 CPU、GPU 與 AI 加速器電源軌。數位迴路提供相位增減、電流平衡、AVS／SVID／SVI3 介面、非線性暫態響應與 PMBus 遙測。

en: A diode bridge followed by a boost converter that shapes the input current into a sine wave in phase with the line voltage, while regulating a ~380–400 V DC bus for the next stage. Above about 75 W, mains-powered supplies need PFC to meet IEC 61000-3-2 harmonic limits. Average current mode control in CCM is the classic choice at hundreds of watts and above; interleaving two or three phases cuts input ripple.
zh: 二極體整流橋後接一級升壓轉換器，把輸入電流整形成與市電電壓同相位的正弦波，同時把直流匯流排穩定在約 380–400 V 供下一級使用。市電輸入、功率超過約 75 W 的電源需要 PFC 才能符合 IEC 61000-3-2 諧波限制。數百瓦以上最常用 CCM 平均電流模式控制；兩相或三相交錯（interleave）可降低輸入漣波。
formula: PF = P / (V_rms · I_rms);  V_bus / V_in = 1 / (1 − D)

digital.en: The MCU runs a fast inner current loop and a slow outer bus-voltage loop, plus input-voltage feedforward, phase shedding at light load, brown-in/out and inrush control in firmware.
digital.zh: MCU 執行快速的內層電流迴路與慢速的外層匯流排電壓迴路，並以韌體實作輸入電壓前饋、輕載相位卸載（phase shedding）、欠壓保護與湧浪電流控制。

en: Mature, well understood
Ground-referenced switch, easy to drive
Interleaving scales power and lowers ripple
zh: 技術成熟、資料豐富
開關以地為參考，驅動簡單
交錯並聯可擴充功率並降低漣波

en: Bridge diodes conduct all the time (~1–2% loss)
Bulky boost inductor and bulk capacitor
Output bus is always above the line peak
zh: 整流二極體持續導通，損失約 1–2%
升壓電感與大電容體積大
輸出匯流排電壓必須高於市電峰值

sources.title: Infineon – PFC CCM boost converter design guide
NXP AN5257 – Interleaved PFC control theory
ST AN5235 – 3 kW interleaved PFC with digital controller

en: A bridgeless PFC that removes the diode bridge: one half-bridge leg of GaN or SiC FETs switches at high frequency, and a second leg (FETs or diodes) commutates at the line frequency. CCM operation needs switches without reverse recovery, which is why it took off with wide-bandgap devices. It reaches about 99% efficiency and is common in titanium-rated server and telecom supplies.
zh: 拿掉整流二極體橋的無橋 PFC：一個半橋臂用 GaN 或 SiC 以高頻切換，另一個臂（MOSFET 或二極體）以市電頻率換向。CCM 操作要求開關沒有反向恢復，因此是隨著寬能隙元件才普及。效率可達約 99%，常見於 Titanium 等級的伺服器與通訊電源。
formula: Fast leg: V_bus / |v_ac| = 1 / (1 − D);  slow leg flips at each zero crossing

digital.en: Practically requires digital control: the fast leg's roles (boost switch vs. sync rectifier) swap every half cycle, and the controller must soft-start the duty cycle around the AC zero crossing to avoid current spikes. CCM, CrM/TCM and multimode schemes are all done in firmware.
digital.zh: 實務上幾乎一定要數位控制：快速臂的角色（升壓開關或同步整流）每半個週期互換，控制器必須在交流過零點附近緩啟動占空比，避免電流尖峰。CCM、CrM/TCM 以及多模式控制都在韌體中實作。

en: No bridge-diode loss, ~99% efficiency
Fewest power semiconductors of the bridgeless PFCs
Bidirectional with active slow leg (V2G, battery storage)
zh: 沒有整流橋損失，效率約 99%
在無橋 PFC 中功率元件最少
慢速臂用主動開關即可雙向（V2G、儲能）

en: Needs GaN/SiC for CCM
Current spikes at zero crossing need careful control
Isolated current and voltage sensing
zh: CCM 需要 GaN/SiC
過零點電流尖峰需仔細控制
電流與電壓需隔離取樣

sources.title: TI TIDUF22 – 4 kW CCM totem-pole PFC with GaN and C2000
TI SPRADQ1 – TCM totem-pole PFC control with C2000 and GaN
TI TIDT257 – 3 kW GaN CCM totem-pole PFC test report

en: An isolated DC-DC converter whose half or full bridge drives a series resonant tank (Lr, Cr) plus the transformer magnetizing inductance Lm. The bridge runs at ~50% duty and the output is regulated by changing the switching frequency. Near the resonant frequency the primary switches turn on at zero voltage and the rectifiers turn off at zero current, so it is the usual second stage after a PFC in server, TV and adapter supplies.
zh: 隔離式 DC-DC 轉換器，半橋或全橋驅動串聯諧振槽（Lr、Cr）加上變壓器激磁電感 Lm。橋臂以約 50% 占空比工作，靠改變切換頻率來穩壓。在諧振頻率附近，一次側開關零電壓導通、整流器零電流關斷，因此是伺服器、電視與變壓器電源中 PFC 後級的常見選擇。
formula: f_r = 1 / (2π√(L_r·C_r));  at f_sw = f_r: V_out = (V_in / 2) / n  (half bridge, n = N_p/N_s)

digital.en: Digital control handles frequency modulation with clamps, burst mode at light load, synchronous-rectifier timing, soft start, and hybrid or charge control. A high-resolution period (not just duty) is needed because gain changes steeply with frequency.
digital.zh: 數位控制負責帶上下限的頻率調變、輕載突衝模式（burst mode）、同步整流時序、軟啟動，以及混合式或電荷控制。由於增益隨頻率變化很陡，需要高解析度的週期（不只是占空比）控制。

en: ZVS on primary, ZCS on rectifiers
Very high efficiency at the nominal point
Magnetics can be integrated into one transformer
zh: 一次側 ZVS、整流側 ZCS
額定工作點效率極高
磁性元件可整合進單一變壓器

en: Narrow input range for good efficiency
Variable frequency complicates EMI and loop design
Light-load regulation needs burst mode
zh: 高效率的輸入範圍窄
變頻使 EMI 與迴路設計更複雜
輕載穩壓需要 burst mode

sources.title: Infineon – Design of a 600 W HB LLC converter using CoolMOS P6
TI SLUP263 – Designing an LLC resonant half-bridge power converter
TI SSZTCH0 – LLC design: gain charts and frequency range

en: A flyback whose leakage-inductance energy goes into a clamp capacitor through an extra high-side switch instead of being burned in an RCD snubber. Running the clamp switch also lets the magnetizing current go negative, discharging the main switch's capacitance so it turns on at zero voltage. Paired with GaN it is the standard topology for small, high-density USB-PD adapters around 30–150 W.
zh: 在返馳式中加一顆高側開關，把漏感能量送進箝位電容，而不是消耗在 RCD 緩衝電路上。操作箝位開關還能讓激磁電流反向，在主開關導通前把它的寄生電容放電，達成零電壓切換。搭配 GaN 是約 30–150 W 高功率密度 USB-PD 變壓器的標準拓樸。
formula: V_out / V_in = D / (n·(1 − D)),  n = N_p/N_s

digital.en: The controller adapts the clamp-switch on-time and dead time cycle by cycle to hit ZVS across line and load, and moves between modes (transition mode, burst) as load drops. Dedicated ACF controllers do this in a hardware state machine.
digital.zh: 控制器逐週期調整箝位開關導通時間與死區時間，在不同輸入電壓與負載下都達成 ZVS，並隨負載降低切換工作模式（transition mode、burst）。專用 ACF 控制器以硬體狀態機完成這些工作。

en: Recycles leakage energy, no snubber loss
ZVS allows high frequency and small magnetics
Low parts count for an isolated converter
zh: 回收漏感能量，沒有緩衝電路損失
ZVS 允許高頻與小型磁性元件
以隔離式轉換器而言零件數少

en: Extra high-side switch and driver
ZVS tuning is load and line dependent
Practical limit around 150 W
zh: 多一顆高側開關與驅動
ZVS 調校隨負載與輸入電壓變化
實用上限約 150 W

sources.title: TI SLUAAG2 – UCC28782 ACF practical design guidelines
TI SLUA871 – Increasing power density with the ACF controller UCC28780

en: A non-inverting converter with one inductor between a buck half-bridge (input side) and a boost half-bridge (output side). It can step up or down, so the output stays regulated whether the input is above, below or equal to it. Used for USB-PD sources, automotive rails that see cold crank and load dump, battery chargers, and solar optimizers.
zh: 非反相轉換器，以一顆電感連接輸入側的降壓半橋與輸出側的升壓半橋。可升壓也可降壓，不論輸入電壓高於、低於或等於輸出都能穩壓。用於 USB-PD 供電端、需承受冷啟動與拋負載的車用電源軌、電池充電器與太陽能優化器。
formula: Buck: V_out = D₁·V_in;  Boost: V_out = V_in / (1 − D₂);  Buck-boost: V_out / V_in = D₁ / (1 − D₂)

digital.en: The hard part is the transition region where V_in ≈ V_out. Digital controllers choose the mode (buck, boost, or all four switches active), add hysteresis between modes, and blend the duty cycles so the output stays smooth. They can also run it bidirectionally.
digital.zh: 難點在 V_in ≈ V_out 的過渡區。數位控制器決定工作模式（降壓、升壓或四開關同時切換），在模式之間加入遲滯，並平滑地銜接占空比讓輸出不跳動，也可以做雙向操作。

en: Wide input range above and below V_out
Single inductor, non-inverting
Synchronous, so it can be bidirectional
zh: 輸入範圍可涵蓋高於與低於 V_out
單電感、非反相輸出
全同步，可雙向操作

en: Four switches and drivers
Mode transitions need careful control
Higher inductor RMS current in buck-boost mode
zh: 需要四顆開關與驅動
模式切換需仔細控制
升降壓模式下電感 RMS 電流較大

sources.title: TI SLYT765 – Multimode control for a four-switch buck-boost converter
TI TIDT262 – >300 W automotive four-switch buck-boost test report

en: An isolated full-bridge converter in which both legs run at ~50% duty and the output is set by the phase shift between them. The transformer leakage (plus an optional resonant inductor) lets the switches turn on at zero voltage. A long-standing choice for 500 W–5 kW telecom, server and EV auxiliary supplies with wide input ranges.
zh: 隔離式全橋轉換器，兩個橋臂都以約 50% 占空比工作，以兩臂之間的相移決定輸出。利用變壓器漏感（可加諧振電感）讓開關零電壓導通。長期以來是 500 W–5 kW、寬輸入範圍的通訊、伺服器與電動車輔助電源的常用拓樸。
formula: V_out ≈ D_eff · V_in / n,  D_eff = phase shift / 180°

digital.en: Digital controllers make the dead time adaptive per leg so ZVS holds at light load, run peak current mode with slope compensation, and drive synchronous rectifiers. Phase-shift resolution is just as important as PWM resolution.
digital.zh: 數位控制器讓每個橋臂的死區時間自適應，使輕載仍維持 ZVS，並實作帶斜率補償的峰值電流模式與同步整流驅動。相移解析度和 PWM 解析度一樣重要。

en: ZVS with fixed frequency
Handles wide input range
Well-proven at kW level
zh: 固定頻率即可 ZVS
可應付寬輸入範圍
千瓦級應用經驗豐富

en: Loses ZVS on the lagging leg at light load
Duty-cycle loss and secondary ringing
Circulating current lowers efficiency vs. LLC
zh: 輕載時落後臂失去 ZVS
占空比損失與二次側振鈴
環流使效率不如 LLC

sources.title: Analog Devices AN-1336 – Adaptive dead time in phase-shifted full bridge (ADP1055)
TI SPRABR1 – Digitally controlled PSFB with C2000
TI SLUA107 – PSFB zero-voltage transition design considerations

en: Two active full bridges, one on each side of a transformer, linked by a series inductance. Both bridges run at 50% duty, and power flows from the leading bridge to the lagging one, set by the phase shift φ between them. It is naturally bidirectional with soft switching, so it is used in EV on-board and DC fast chargers, battery storage and solid-state transformers.
zh: 變壓器兩側各一個主動全橋，以串聯電感連接。兩個橋都以 50% 占空比工作，功率由相位超前的一側流向落後的一側，大小由兩橋之間的相移 φ 決定。天生雙向且具軟切換，用於電動車車載與直流快充、儲能系統與固態變壓器。
formula: P = n·V₁·V₂·φ·(π − |φ|) / (2π²·f_s·L)   (single phase shift, φ in rad)

digital.en: Control is almost always digital: the MCU computes the phase shift (single, extended, dual or triple phase shift) to regulate current or voltage in both directions and to keep ZVS and low circulating current as the voltage ratio changes.
digital.zh: 幾乎都是數位控制：MCU 計算相移量（單相移、擴展相移、雙相移或三相移），在兩個方向上調節電流或電壓，並在電壓比變化時維持 ZVS 與低環流。

en: Inherently bidirectional
Soft switching on both bridges
Symmetric structure, high power density
zh: 天生雙向
兩側橋臂皆可軟切換
結構對稱、功率密度高

en: Loses ZVS when the voltage ratio mismatches
High circulating current at light load
Eight switches plus advanced modulation
zh: 電壓比不匹配時失去 ZVS
輕載時環流大
八顆開關並需要進階調變

sources.title: TI TIDA-010054 – Bidirectional single-phase DAB reference design
MathWorks – Dual active bridge converter model

en: A pin the firmware can configure as a digital input or output. Typical options are direction, internal pull-up/pull-down, push-pull or open-drain output, drive strength and input qualification (sampling filter). Most GPIOs are multiplexed with peripheral functions such as PWM, UART or ADC.
zh: 可由韌體設定為數位輸入或輸出的腳位。常見設定有方向、內部上拉／下拉、推挽或開汲極輸出、驅動能力，以及輸入取樣濾波（input qualification）。多數 GPIO 會與 PWM、UART、ADC 等週邊功能共用腳位（pin mux）。

en: A resistor that holds a line at a defined level when nothing drives it: a pull-up ties it to VCC, a pull-down to GND. Open-drain/open-collector signals need a pull-up to read high. Smaller values give faster edges and better noise immunity but draw more current when the line is low (I = VCC/R).
zh: 在沒有任何元件驅動時，把訊號線固定在確定電位的電阻：上拉接 VCC，下拉接 GND。開汲極／開集極訊號需要上拉才能讀到高電位。阻值越小，邊緣越快、抗雜訊越好，但線被拉低時耗電越大（I = VCC/R）。
formula: I_low = VCC / R_pull,  τ_rise ≈ R_pull · C_line

en: An output that can only pull the line low; high comes from an external pull-up. Several devices can share one line (wired-AND), and the pull-up can go to a different voltage than the driver's supply, which makes it useful for level shifting. I²C, SMBus and many sensors, coin acceptors and alert lines use it. When one pull-up is shared, a low on one input can back-feed into another; series diodes or optocouplers isolate the lines.
zh: 只能把線拉低的輸出，高電位由外部上拉電阻提供。多個裝置可共用同一條線（wired-AND），上拉也可接到與驅動端不同的電壓，因此可做電位轉換。I²C、SMBus、許多感測器、投幣器與警示腳位都使用此方式。若多條線共用上拉或接點，一條線拉低可能倒灌到另一條，可用串聯二極體或光耦隔離。

en: Input thresholds: a voltage below V_IL reads as 0, above V_IH reads as 1, and the band in between is undefined. Output levels V_OL/V_OH are guaranteed at a stated load current. Noise margin is V_IL − V_OL (low) and V_OH − V_IH (high). A series diode adds its forward drop (≈0.3 V Schottky, ≈0.7 V silicon) to the low level, so check it still falls below V_IL. '5 V tolerant' pins accept 5 V while the MCU runs at 3.3 V.
zh: 輸入門檻：低於 V_IL 讀為 0，高於 V_IH 讀為 1，中間區域不保證。輸出電位 V_OL/V_OH 在指定負載電流下保證。雜訊邊限為 V_IL − V_OL（低）與 V_OH − V_IH（高）。串聯二極體會讓低電位多出順向壓降（蕭特基約 0.3 V、矽約 0.7 V），需確認仍低於 V_IL。標示「5 V tolerant」的腳位可在 3.3 V MCU 上承受 5 V 輸入。
formula: NM_L = V_IL − V_OL,  NM_H = V_OH − V_IH

en: An input with hysteresis: it switches high at a higher threshold (V_T+) than it switches low (V_T−). Slow or noisy edges therefore produce one clean transition instead of a burst. Many MCU GPIOs have it built in; it complements, but does not replace, debouncing for mechanical contacts.
zh: 具遲滯的輸入：由低轉高的門檻（V_T+）高於由高轉低的門檻（V_T−）。緩慢或帶雜訊的邊緣因此只產生一次乾淨的轉態，而不是一連串抖動。許多 MCU 的 GPIO 內建此功能；它能輔助但無法取代機械接點的去彈跳。

en: Filtering the rapid on/off chatter of a mechanical contact or noisy signal so one event is counted once. Hardware options are an RC filter plus Schmitt trigger; firmware options sample the pin periodically and accept a new state only after it is stable for N samples (often 5–20 ms total), or ignore edges for a lockout time after each event.
zh: 濾除機械接點或雜訊訊號在切換時的快速抖動，讓一次事件只被計數一次。硬體做法為 RC 濾波加施密特觸發；韌體做法為週期性取樣，連續 N 次狀態相同才接受（總時間常取 5–20 ms），或在每次事件後設定一段忽略邊緣的鎖定時間。

en: A hardware event (pin edge, timer, ADC end-of-conversion, communication) that suspends the main program and runs an interrupt service routine. Triggers can be edge (rising/falling) or level. Interrupt latency and priority matter in digital power: the control-loop ISR is usually triggered by the ADC at a fixed rate and must finish well within one switching period.
zh: 由硬體事件（腳位邊緣、計時器、ADC 轉換完成、通訊）暫停主程式並執行中斷服務程式（ISR）。觸發方式分為邊緣觸發（上升／下降）與準位觸發。在數位電源中，中斷延遲與優先權很重要：控制迴路 ISR 通常由 ADC 以固定頻率觸發，必須在一個開關週期內充裕地完成。

en: An LED and phototransistor in one package that passes a signal across an isolation barrier. It separates grounds and voltage domains (e.g. a 12 V machine signal into a 3.3 V MCU) and blocks back-feeding between lines. Current transfer ratio (CTR) sets the needed LED current; common parts like PC817 are slow (tens of µs), so use digital isolators for fast signals.
zh: 將 LED 與光電晶體封裝在一起，跨越隔離屏障傳遞訊號。可分隔地線與電壓域（例如把 12 V 機台訊號接到 3.3 V MCU），並阻止訊號線之間互相倒灌。電流傳輸比（CTR）決定所需的 LED 電流；PC817 等常見元件速度較慢（數十 µs），高速訊號應改用數位隔離器。

en: A timer mode that latches the counter value when an input edge arrives. Differences between captures give period, frequency or pulse width without CPU polling, e.g. measuring fan tach, coin pulses, or the frequency of an LLC stage.
zh: 計時器的一種模式：輸入邊緣到達時鎖存當下的計數值。兩次捕捉的差值即可得到週期、頻率或脈寬，不需 CPU 輪詢，例如量測風扇轉速、投幣脈衝或 LLC 的工作頻率。

en: The PWM peripheral of power-oriented MCUs such as TI C2000. Each module has a time base (up, down or up-down count), compare registers, action qualifiers, a dead-band generator, trip-zone inputs, phase sync between modules, and event triggers that start ADC conversions.
zh: 電源導向 MCU（如 TI C2000）的 PWM 週邊。每個模組包含時基（上數、下數或上下數）、比較暫存器、動作限定器（action qualifier）、死區產生器、Trip Zone 輸入、模組間相位同步，以及觸發 ADC 轉換的事件輸出。

en: A short delay inserted between turning one switch of a half-bridge off and the complementary switch on, so both never conduct at once (shoot-through). It is set in clock counts; too little risks shoot-through, too much increases body-diode conduction loss and distorts the effective duty.
zh: 在半橋的一個開關關斷與互補開關導通之間插入的短暫延遲，避免上下管同時導通（直通，shoot-through）。以時脈計數設定；太短有直通風險，太長則增加本體二極體導通損耗並使有效占空比失真。

en: A hardware path that forces PWM outputs to a safe state (low, high or high-Z) within tens of nanoseconds when a fault input or comparator event fires, without waiting for software. One-shot trips latch until firmware clears them; cycle-by-cycle trips release at the next period and act as peak-current limiting.
zh: 當故障輸入或比較器事件發生時，不經軟體、在數十奈秒內把 PWM 輸出強制到安全狀態（低、高或高阻抗）的硬體路徑。One-shot 模式會鎖住直到韌體清除；cycle-by-cycle 模式在下一週期自動釋放，可做逐週期峰值電流限制。

en: On-chip comparators with a DAC reference (TI calls the block CMPSS) that compare a current or voltage sense signal against a threshold and feed the result straight to the PWM trip logic. Used for over-current and over-voltage protection and for peak-current-mode control, often with a ramp generator for slope compensation.
zh: 內建 DAC 參考電壓的晶片內比較器（TI 稱為 CMPSS），把電流或電壓感測訊號與門檻比較，結果直接送到 PWM 的 Trip 邏輯。用於過電流、過電壓保護，以及峰值電流模式控制，常搭配斜坡產生器做斜率補償。

en: Start-of-conversion signal that launches an ADC sample, usually from a PWM event (counter = zero, period or a compare value) so the sample lands at a quiet point, e.g. the middle of the on-time to read average inductor current. The end-of-conversion interrupt then runs the control loop.
zh: 啟動 ADC 取樣的轉換開始訊號，通常來自 PWM 事件（計數 = 0、= 週期或某個比較值），讓取樣落在雜訊較小的時間點，例如在導通期間中點取樣以讀到電感平均電流。轉換完成中斷接著執行控制迴路。

en: A TI C2000 co-processor with its own floating-point unit that runs control-loop tasks in parallel with the main CPU. It can read ADC results and write PWM registers directly, cutting loop latency and freeing the CPU for communication and housekeeping.
zh: TI C2000 內建、具浮點運算單元的協處理器，可與主 CPU 平行執行控制迴路任務。它能直接讀取 ADC 結果並寫入 PWM 暫存器，降低迴路延遲，讓主 CPU 專心處理通訊與管理工作。

en: A phase-locked loop multiplies a crystal or internal oscillator up to the system clock. The PWM clock sets PWM resolution (N = f_clk/f_sw), so clock accuracy and jitter matter. Internal RC oscillators drift a few percent; use a crystal when UART baud rate or switching frequency must be precise.
zh: 鎖相迴路把石英或內部振盪器倍頻成系統時脈。PWM 時脈決定 PWM 解析度（N = f_clk/f_sw），因此時脈精度與抖動都會影響控制。內部 RC 振盪器會漂移數個百分比；UART 鮑率或開關頻率需要精準時應使用石英振盪器。

en: Extra clock cycles inserted on each flash read because flash is slower than the CPU at high clock rates. They slow code executed from flash, so time-critical control ISRs are often copied to RAM at boot and run from there.
zh: 因為高時脈下 Flash 讀取速度跟不上 CPU，每次讀取需插入的額外時脈週期。它會拖慢在 Flash 上執行的程式，因此時間關鍵的控制 ISR 常在開機時複製到 RAM 執行。

en: A controller that moves data between peripherals and memory without the CPU, e.g. streaming ADC results into a buffer or feeding UART/SPI transmit data. It reduces CPU load and interrupt count.
zh: 不經 CPU、在週邊與記憶體之間搬移資料的控制器，例如把 ADC 結果連續寫入緩衝區，或供應 UART/SPI 的傳送資料。可降低 CPU 負載與中斷次數。

en: A timer that resets the MCU if firmware fails to service ('kick') it before it expires, recovering from hangs. Windowed watchdogs also reset on a kick that comes too early. In power supplies, make sure PWM outputs fall to a safe state during the reset.
zh: 若韌體未在逾時前重設（餵狗），就會重置 MCU 的計時器，用來從當機狀態恢復。視窗型看門狗在太早餵狗時也會重置。在電源應用中，需確保重置期間 PWM 輸出處於安全狀態。

en: A supervisor that holds the MCU in reset while its supply is below a threshold, so it never runs with corrupt logic or flash writes during power-up, power-down or sags. Thresholds usually have hysteresis.
zh: 當供電低於門檻時把 MCU 保持在重置狀態的監控電路，避免在上電、斷電或電壓下陷時以錯誤的邏輯運作或寫壞 Flash。門檻通常帶有遲滯。

en: Code that runs at reset and can update the application firmware over UART, CAN, I²C/PMBus or USB. Power products often keep a protected bootloader plus a CRC-checked application image so a failed update can be recovered in the field.
zh: 重置後最先執行的程式，可透過 UART、CAN、I²C/PMBus 或 USB 更新應用程式韌體。電源產品常保留受保護的 bootloader 並以 CRC 檢查應用程式映像，讓更新失敗時仍可在現場恢復。

en: Two-wire open-drain bus (SCL clock, SDA data) with 7-bit addressing at 100 kHz, 400 kHz or 1 MHz. Pull-up value is a trade-off between rise time on the bus capacitance and sink current. SMBus and PMBus are built on it.
zh: 雙線開汲極匯流排（SCL 時脈、SDA 資料），使用 7 位元位址，速度為 100 kHz、400 kHz 或 1 MHz。上拉電阻須在匯流排電容的上升時間與灌入電流之間取捨。SMBus 與 PMBus 建構在其上。

en: Synchronous full-duplex bus with clock (SCLK), MOSI, MISO and a chip select per device. Push-pull lines allow tens of MHz. Clock polarity and phase (CPOL/CPHA, modes 0–3) must match the device. Common for external ADCs, isolators and gate-driver configuration.
zh: 同步全雙工匯流排，包含時脈（SCLK）、MOSI、MISO 及每個裝置一條晶片選擇線。推挽輸出可達數十 MHz。時脈極性與相位（CPOL/CPHA，模式 0–3）必須與裝置一致。常用於外部 ADC、隔離器與閘極驅動器設定。

en: Asynchronous serial link (TX/RX) framed by start and stop bits at an agreed baud rate; TI calls it SCI. Both ends' clocks must agree within roughly ±2%. With an RS-485 transceiver it covers long cables and multi-drop networks.
zh: 以起始位元與停止位元框住資料、雙方約定鮑率的非同步序列連線（TX/RX），TI 稱為 SCI。兩端時脈誤差需在約 ±2% 內。搭配 RS-485 收發器可支援長距離與多點網路。

en: Differential multi-master bus with message-ID arbitration and built-in CRC and error confinement. Classic CAN runs up to 1 Mbit/s with 8-byte payloads; CAN FD raises the data-phase rate and allows 64-byte payloads. Common in automotive chargers, DC/DC converters and battery systems.
zh: 差動式多主控匯流排，以訊息 ID 仲裁，內建 CRC 與錯誤隔離機制。傳統 CAN 最高 1 Mbit/s、每筆 8 位元組；CAN FD 提高資料段速率並支援 64 位元組。常見於車用充電器、DC/DC 轉換器與電池系統。
